tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List WhatsApp, Instagram, Email, X connector status for a support agent.

tools.name: suggest_targets
tools.description: AI-propose Instagram or X @targets for a discovery scan (depth/breadth optional).

tools.name: get_ad_plan
tools.description: The ads this business should run, built from its own scans: three things to film, each citing a count from this agent's own leads, plus the spend and reach for a lead target. Reads only; nothing is launched and no money moves. Returns status=no_evidence when the scans have not found enough to say an

tools.name: get_ad_guide
tools.description: The ad plan rendered as steps to tap, per channel, in the owner's own words with the daily budget already divided. Use this when the owner wants to run the ads themselves. Nova never touches their ad account.

tools.name: list_ad_plans
tools.description: Every ad this agent has already launched, newest first, with its cap, its channel and whether it is running or stopped. Reads only.

tools.name: launch_ad_plan
tools.description: Run one ad on one channel, under a spend cap the owner has named out loud. The cap is debited before anything is created and nothing is ever created above it. Creative is the owner's: this never writes an ad. Needs a connected ad account.

tools.name: stop_ad_plan
tools.description: Switch one launched ad off. The campaign is paused first, so spend stops on the very first call.

tools.name: continue_scan

tools.name: list_scans

tools.name: get_scan

tools.name: list_scan_schedules

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "telegram-agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_connectors · Public sink: list_connectors, run_scan, create_scan_schedule, update_scan_schedule · Destructive: get_ad_plan, get_ad_guide, launch_ad_plan, run_scan, delete_scans, create_scan_schedule, update_scan_schedule, delete_scan_schedule, trigger_scan_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_connectors · Public sink: list_connectors, run_scan, create_scan_schedule, update_scan_schedule · Destructive: get_ad_plan, get_ad_guide, launch_ad_plan, run_scan, delete_scans, create_scan_schedule, update_scan_schedule, delete_scan_schedule, trigger_scan_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
